Context: 2. Pension

| p.m. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |  
- (i) For calculation of Pension and Family Pension, 'Basic Pay', and 'Non-Practising Allowance' (sanctioned to medical posts) will be taken into account. In the case of re-employed pensioner, the element of pension by which his pay is reduced will also be taken into account. For calculating Retirement/ Death Gratuity, in addition to the above, Dearness Allowance admissible on the date of retirement / death while in service will be treated as 'emoluments'.
